text:
I go with the ants

between the legs of flies.

I go with the ground, on the wind,

in men's shoes,

in hooves, leaves, papers;

I go where you go, Tarumba,

I come from where you come.

I know the spider.

I know what you know about yourself

and what your father knew.

I know what you've told me about myself.

I'm afraid of not knowing,

of being here like my grandmother,

staring at the wall, good and dead.

I want to go piss by moonlight.

Tarumba, it looks like rain.
